subject: Sizing and token economics follow-up — reserved GPU family & $/1M targets
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ava Richardson <ava@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Matt Chen <matt.chen@clearwave.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Sizing and token economics follow-up — reserved GPU family & $/1M targets

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the demo and the signal on production targets. This note captures what we heard + concrete next steps so we don’t lose momentum.

Recap of requirements (from today’s call):
- Workload: mixed chat + single-turn generation; average prompt length ~80 tokens, average response length ~220 tokens.
- Peak concurrency: ~45 concurrent sessions.
- Target p50 latency for chat: <= 200 ms; p95 goal <= 600 ms.
- Monthly token volumes (three scenarios):
  • Pilot: 50M tokens/month
  • Scale: 500M tokens/month
  • Run-rate: 3B tokens/month
- Data residency: US-only; will need Private or Dedicated (you preferred Dedicated).

Pricing / budget guidance you shared:~
- Budget band: $6k–$25k/month initial commit (flexible as we get clarity on unit economics).
- Target unit economics: you’re aiming for ~$20–$40 per 1M tokens (initial target), with ability to expand if latency reliably meets SLOs.

GPU family and capacity we discussed:
- Candidate GPUs: A100 80GB, H100, and an inference-optimized L4 class for cheaper high-throughput.
- Reserved options: 2, 4, 8 GPU lanes (we discussed 4 as a likely starting point for the Scale scenario).
- Throughput expectations we modeled on-call: ~40–60k tokens/sec aggregate (depends on batching & KV cache hits).

What I’ll do next (by EOW):
1) Share a concise pricing matrix with per-1M token estimates for the three scenarios and for each GPU family (A100/H100/L4) including assumptions (batching %, cache hit rate, quantization). See attached draft.
2) Put together a recommended reserved SKU for your Scale scenario (4x A100 vs 8x L4 cost/throughput tradeoff) and the impact on p50/p95 latency.
3) Propose a short performance validation plan (48–72 hour reserved lane trial) and a checklist for acceptance criteria.

Requests for you / next steps:
- Can you confirm which scenario (Pilot/Scale/Run-rate) best represents your expected commit for the next 90 days?
- Any hard budget ceiling we should know about beyond the $25k/mo figure?
- If you have an existing token-metered forecast (spreadsheet), please share — I attached our token modeling template in case it helps.

I’ve attached a draft pricing matrix + token modeling workbook. Happy to jump on a follow-up on Wednesday AM PST if that works.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad

Thanks Mina — this is helpful. A few quick items from our side: 
- Likely start with the Scale scenario (~500M tokens/mo) for an initial 3-month commit, then re-evaluate.
- Budget: we can stretch to $30k/mo for initial three months if the numbers line up and latency meets the targets.
- GPU preference: performance-leaning option preferred (H100/A100) but open to mixing with lower-cost inferencing GPUs if the hybrid config meets p95 SLA.
- Two asks: 1) Can you show modeled $/1M for a hybrid mix (2x H100 + 4x L4) vs homogeneous 4x H100? 2) Please include our expected batching profile — average tokens-per-request ~300 with 1.1k requests/sec peak.

If you can get the pricing matrix and a recommended SKU over today, we can review and aim for a redlines call on Friday.

— Ava

Quick notes from my unit-econ run (summary — full sheet in internal drive link):
- Assumptions used: reserved discount 35% for 1yr commit; H100 effective infra cost = $2.50/hr (post-discount normalized), A100 80GB effective = $1.75/hr, L4 inference = $0.55/hr. Ops & reserved overhead added as 20% uplift.
- Modeled $/1M tokens (median-case batching/cache numbers):
  • 4x H100 homogeneous: ~$28 / 1M tokens (meets p50/p95 targets with headroom)
  • 4x A100 homogeneous: ~$34 / 1M tokens (slightly worse p95 under peak without larger batch strategy)
  • Hybrid (2x H100 + 4x L4): ~$22 / 1M tokens (best cost, p95 depends on routing -- must route latency-sensitive requests to H100 lanes)

Recommendation: propose the hybrid as the starting reserved SKU for ClearWave: 2x H100 + 4x L4. Rationale: hits their budget ceiling (~$30k/mo at 500M tokens) while giving a clear path to scale (add additional L4 lanes or convert to homogeneous H100 if p95 SLA is missed). Include a 72-hour validation with sampling rules to verify p95 before committing to 1yr.

Action items I’ll do:
- Upload detailed calc & sensitivity (link below)
- Draft fallback routing policy for hybrid (auto-failover to H100 for chat sessions that show >300ms processing)

Rishi
